description: This Java source file defines the class 'ContactAccessorSdk5', which extends 'ContactAccessor'. It provides functionality to retrieve contact information using the Android Contacts API, including methods to create an intent for picking contacts and to load contact details such as display name and phone number from the contact URI.

classes.name: ContactAccessorSdk5
classes.description: A class extending 'ContactAccessor' that uses the current Android Contacts API to access contact data, including methods for creating a contact pick intent and loading contact details such as name and phone number.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Returns an Intent to pick a contact using the standard contacts URI.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact information such as display name and phone number from a given contact URI using ContentResolver queries.
